product.name: Brett Martin Cascade Cast Iron Style Plastic 106mm Prostyle Gutter
product.description:
The sleek lines and modern styling of the Prostyle Cast Iron Style Rainwater System provides a more contemporary finish with a quality cast iron look and feel.
Available in up to 4m lengths, the guttering must slope gently downwards at least 12mm every 3m towards the running outlet in order to provide effective drainage.
It should be fixed at 1m intervals with a gutter support bracket.
Offering a modern twist on heritage styling, the Prostyle system is ideally suited to traditionally styled new build projects.
Features

Authentic detailing and finish on guttering, downpipe, hoppers and fittings
Fully compatible with the Cast Iron Style Soil System and traditional Cast Iron

product.description:
Taking a unique and contemporary spin on a traditional style of guttering, the Cascade Prostyle range from Brett Martin features this plastic union bracket that sturdily joins together two gutter parts.

product.name: Alumasc Aqualine Half Round Starter Pack
product.description: This Aqualine starter pack contains the tools required to install your Half Round extruded aluminium gutter system. This includes P80 joint seal lubricant, 2 jointing tools, 10 spare slide locks, 20 spare number 12 screws, 8 spare seal strips and 20 shims for filling gaps. This starter pack provides you with the necessary tools for a successful and easy installation.  This starter pack is quick and easy to use with the Aqualine gutter system using a unique, all-weather ‘dry’ jointing system with concealed site fixing and jointing that gives a completely clean external appearance. The Half Round gutters drop and lock onto concealed brackets where internal joints are dry-sealed, aligned and locked using sliding single front lock bars. This starter pack ensures a fully secure gutter system allowing free linear thermal movement.Features & Benefits: Alumasc Aqualine Half Round Starter PackQuick and easy to use and install your Half Round gutter system  Helps to enhance buildings with intricate details, smooth lines and secret fix bracketry giving a completely clean appearance  Lightweight materials to work with making them easy to handle  Minimal maintenance needed once guttering is installed  Available in a range of gutter diameters  Environmentally friendly guttering, made from robust, non-corrosive, recyclable aluminiumThis Aqualine starter pack will help to ensure smooth lines and intricate detailing to contemporary designed buildings with the Half Round guttering with a high flow capacity for enhanced performance. The Half Round gutter systems are suitable for both flush and projecting eaves applications which can be perfected with the help of your starter pack.

product.name: Alumasc Aqualine Half Round Internal Angle
product.description: Part of Alumasc's Aqualine range, this half round internal angle is designed to be installed as a corner of a guttering system. Installation is simple, with a simple clip fix required to support the brackets once they've been attached to the building fabric with concealed bracketry and versatile dry-sealed joints using internal unions positioned by sliding lock bars. Concealed site fixing and jointing enable the internal angle to fit in with the intricate detailing and smooth lines. Ensuring a clean appearance and secure installation that compliments and enhances the architectural design of your modern building. The design is also lightweight, compact and efficient, enhancing performance and high flow capacity; fully accommodating thermal movement at every joint. This prevents potential damage of cracking and splitting. BBA certification also applies to the guttering as its coating is a factory-applied polyester powder. So you can rely on the quality and colour of guttering to last for years to come. product.name: Alumasc Aqualine Deep Run Union Clip
product.description: This Deep Run union clip can be used to join two sections of gutter together while fixed to the fascia board to support the joint. This clean external appearance contributes to the smooth lines and intricate detailing, improving and complementing the architectural character and appearance of modern designed buildings. Manufactured as part of the extruded aluminium Half Round guttering system, this stop-end is part of an efficient and compact rainwater system.Enhancing and complementing the appearance and architectural appeal of modern designed buildings, this Aqualine stop-end is part of the Half Round gutter system that displays intricate detailing and smooth lines and is perfect for both flush and eaves applications. This stop-end fully accommodates free linear thermal movement, reducing the risk of damage through cracking or splitting, and enhances the high flow capacity and performance of the Half Round guttering. This robust and non-corrodible aluminium stop-end is long-lasting with minimal maintenance required after installation and a life expectancy of 40 years (rural/suburban areas) and up to 25 years (industrial/marine areas).Features & Benefits: Alumasc Aqualine Half Round Stop-EndAvailable in a variety of colours with BBA approved process for factory-applied polyester powder coatings  Uses a unique, all-weather ‘dry’ jointing system for a clean exterior appearance  Made from 100% recyclable and environmentally friendly aluminium  Made from non-corrodible and robust aluminium with a life expectancy of 40 years (rural/ suburban areas) and up to 25 years (industrial/ marine areas)  Lightweight and easy to install and handle  Minimal maintenance requirements  Enhances buildings with smooth lines, intricate details and secret fix bracketry  Available in a range sizes with left and right-handed stop-ends  Has a high flow capacity for enhanced performance   Suitable for both flush and projecting eaves applications  Manufactured in the UK to British standards  Manufactured with aluminium extrusions 6063 T6 alloy to BS EN 573: BS EN 755, BS EN 12020 and BS 9101Light and easy to install, this stop-end uses concealed site fixing and jointing with dry sealed joints using internal unions secured by sliding lock bars and a simple clip fix once support brackets have been fixed to the building fabric for a completely clean external appearance and straightforward and secure installation. Available in a variety of factory-applied BBA certified polyester powder colour coatings and in a range of diameters with your choice of left or right-handed stop-end.

To complement Cast Iron Style Domestic and High Capacity Rainwater Systems, the Cascade range includes a comprehensive 110mm Cast Iron Style Soil System with a realistic cast iron finish.

Integrates with Brett Martin Underground Drainage Systems.

product.name: Brett Martin Cascade Cast Iron Style 110mm Plastic Single Socket Access Bend
product.description: This single socket access bend works fantastically in soil and waste systems where a 92.5º angle is needed. It also features an access point for easily clearing away any blockages that may occur. Designed for making sturdy connections with one end of the bend featuring a socket seal and the other ready to be sealed into another socket, Brett Martin strategically created this innovative single socket access bend to replicate genuine cast iron systems like the other items in the impressive Cascade range. It is durable and lightweight for straightforward installations that are only made easier with simple and efficient push-fit connections. product.description: Designed with long-lasting rubber seals, retained by strong snap caps, this double socket boss branch is quick and easy to install with a convenient Push-fit installation for prolonged reliability and minimal maintenance. Made from robust uPVC, this branch is durable, corrosion-resistant and UV stabilised ensuring a secure and reliable installation. Fully complementing the Cast Iron Style High Capacity and Domestic Rainwater systems, this branch is part of the Push-fit Cast Iron Soil System and can be integrated into the Brett Martin Underground Drainage System at ground level. This offset pipe is part of Brett Martin's excellent 'Cascade' range of rainwater products, combining an authentic cast-iron traditional look with the clear convenience of modern materials. This offset section pipe is a perfect pairing for domestic rainwater systems, sporting a range of popular colours and standard sizes. Cost-effective, authentically designed, and with longevity in mind, this offset pipe is ideal for a range of repairs, refits, and ground up builds across your next guttering project.Both cost-effective and authentically designed, this offset pipe imitates genuine cast iron while incorporating the benefits of modern plastic systems. It is perfect for use in both renovated and new build projects.

product.name: Brett Martin Cascade Cast Iron Style 110mm Plastic Double Socket Bend
product.description: With a choice of 92.5º angle or 135º angle available, depending on your personal requirements, this double socket bend is a versatile and exceptionally useful product for your push-fit soil systems.The Cascade iron style range from Brett Martin includes a selection of push-fit soil products that are lightweight and provide straightforward but still reliable connections, and this double socket bend is just one of those multiple products. product.name: Brett Martin Cascade Cast Iron Style Corner Round Plastic Downpipe
product.description:
This Roundstyle uPVC plastic downpipe aims to create a steady path that effortlessly directs rainwater towards the pipe shoe and to the drain. Including lugs for easy and quick attachments, this plastic downpipe fits neatly into a 68mm downpipe system that settles into a corner. 
Like its fellow Cascade products, this Roundstyle downpipe features a cast iron adjacent finish that creates a rustic and traditional feel. While this downpipe is suited to newer applications, it is also ideal for modern refurbishments on heritage buildings where cast iron products may need replacing. In this Cascade downpipe, Brett Martin provides a versatile product that successfully fulfills its purpose and that can increase efficiency in authentic cast iron systems. Features & Benefits: Brett Martin Cascade Cast Iron Style Corner Round Plastic DownpipeA range of sizes accessible  Quality plastic that deters damage and breakage  UV stabilised to prevent sun bleaching  Roundstyle profile  Corrosion resilient  Lightweight for easy handling and installing.

product.description:

Perfect for complementing the architectural detailing on heritage buildings, this downpipe clip is ideal for renovation projects and period styled new builds. product.name: Brett Martin Cascade Cast Iron Style Corner Round Plastic Small Ogee Hopper
product.description:
The Cascade corner downpipe system is synonymous with traditional cast iron styling and blends perfectly with the architectural detailing on heritage buildings, being virtually indistinguishable from original cast iron systems. This system is used on the corners of properties.
The authentic styling of the round downpipe system is suitable for both period styled new build and renovation projects alike.
Pipe couplers allow for more than one downpipe to be connected in series. Cast iron connectors are sometimes decoratively branded. Plastic downpipes may, however, just join by sitting the upper pipe inside the lower, without connectors, which creates a watertight seal.
Funnel-shaped rainwater collector that diverts to a downpipe.
Features

Authentic detailing and finish on guttering, downpipe, hoppers and fittings
Fully compatible with the Cast Iron Style Soil System and traditional Cast Iron

The Cascade corner downpipe system is synonymous with traditional cast iron styling and blends perfectly with the architectural detailing on heritage buildings, being virtually indistinguishable from original cast iron systems. This system is used on the corners of properties.
The authentic styling of the round downpipe system is suitable for both period styled new build and renovation projects alike.
Pipe couplers allow for more than one downpipe to be connected in series. Cast iron connectors are sometimes decoratively branded. Plastic downpipes may, however, just join by sitting the upper pipe inside the lower, without connectors, which creates a watertight seal.
Funnel-shaped rainwater collector that diverts to a downpipe.
Features

Authentic detailing and finish on guttering, downpipe, hoppers and fittings
Fully compatible with the Cast Iron Style Soil System and traditional Cast Iron

Fully compatible with the Cast Iron Style Soil System and traditional Cast Iron
Incorporates 65mm Square Downpipe and 68mm Round Downpipe

Ideal for channelling rainwater from your roof into your drains, this uPVC downpipe is available in a range of heritage colours, lengths and diameters to choose from and fit the architectural appearance of your building. Ready to fit, this downpipe is easy to install with the Cast Iron Style Round downpipe fittings.
Perfectly suited for traditionally designed buildings, renovation projects and period styled new builds, this downpipe blends perfectly with the architectural detail of heritage buildings with authentic detailing and finish and the appearance of original Cast Iron. As an affordable, lighter alternative to traditional cast iron styling, this uPVC downpipe is durable, non-corrosive and UV resistant ensuring a reliable and secure installation with low maintenance requirements. Fully compatible with existing rainwater systems, this downpipe can be incorporated with the Roundstyle or Deepstyle Domestic Rainwater System at 68mm and with the Deepstyle High Capacity Rainwater System at 105mm.
Features & Benefits: Brett Martin Cascade Cast Iron Style Round Plastic Downpipe Quick and easy to install and ready to fit  Available in a wide range of heritage colours, lengths and diameters to choose from  Made from durable, non-corrosive and UV resistant uPVC material  Authentic detailing and finish for your architectural needs for renovation projects, traditionally designed buildings and period styled new builds  Lightweight and affordable alternative to cast iron  Low maintenance requirements with a reliable and secure installation  Made to British Standards  Can be incorporated with the Deepstyle or Roundstyle Domestic Rainwater Systems or the Deepstyle High Capacity Rainwater System with the Cast Iron Style Round Downpipe fittings  Fully compatible with traditional Cast Iron, the Cast Iron Style Soil System and existing rainwater systemsThis downpipe is fully compatible with the Cast Iron Soil System and traditional Cast Iron. The 105mm downpipe can be part of a higher drainage efficiency of rainwater for larger roof areas ensuring a higher capacity rainwater system, making it ideal for a variety of large heritage style buildings.

product.name: Brett Martin Cascade Cast Iron Style Round Plastic Plain Pipe Coupler
product.description:
Use this pipe coupler to connect more than one downpipe in a run to scale higher or more difficult building facades. Sitting a Cascade Cast Iron Style downpipe in the top of this pipe coupler will offer a watertight seal without the need for any other fixings.
Cascade Cast Iron Style Guttering
Achieve all the benefits of plastic guttering with all the traditional and period style looks of Cascade Cast Iron Style guttering. Manufactured from plastic, the guttering is designed to look like cast iron so it’s a match to heritage and listed properties. As the plastic cast iron style guttering isn’t as heavy as actual cast iron guttering you can be reassured that installing new guttering won’t make any damage to the property.

product.name: Brett Martin Cascade Cast Iron Style Round Plastic 112.5 Degree Spigot Bend with Lugs
product.description:
With both left-handed and right-handed options offered, this cast iron Roundstyle spigot bend from Brett Martin’s Cascade range successfully directs the downpipe of your system to the wall where it can be securely attached with the provided lugs. 
By creating a 112.5º angle, this spigot bend makes it so rainwater can easily run from the guttering down to the downpipe without any added hindrance, while simultaneously avoiding any inconvenient pileup of debris. In doing this, your system is less likely to run into irritating buildups that could interrupt the flow of water on its way to the drain. This means that your pipes will work smoothly and effectively. Available in a wide variety of colours, diameters and angles to fit around obstructions and corners of your building, this pipe bend will help direct rainwater from your gutters into the drains below, ensuring water runs vertically, reducing debris build-up. Ideal for renovation projects, period styled new builds and traditionally designed buildings.
With authentic finish and detailing, this pipe bend is synonymous with traditional cast iron styling and blends perfectly with the architectural detailing on heritage buildings and is virtually impossible to differentiate from original Cast Iron systems. The 68mm pipe bend is efficiently compatible with the Roundstyle and Deepstyle Domestic Rainwater System while the 105mm pipe bend is compatible with the Deepstyle High Capacity Rainwater System. The Deepstyle compatibility ensures a higher capacity semi-elliptical rainwater system and provides higher drainage efficiency on larger roof areas making it perfect for a great variety of large heritage style buildings.Features & Benefits: Brett Martin Cascade Cast Iron Style Round Plastic Pipe BendFully UV stabilised, resisting sun damage  Available in a range of colours, diameters and angles to fit your building requirements  Authentic detailing and finish for traditionally designed buildings, renovation projects and period styled new builds  Robust and non-corrodible uPVC material  Lightweight and affordable alternative to cast iron  Ready to fit for a fast, easy, safe and cost-effective installation  Minimal maintenance requirements with a secure and reliable installation  Made in accordance with British Standards  Compatible with existing rainwater systems, Cast Iron Style Soil System and traditional Cast IronFully compatible with traditional Cast Iron, the Cast Iron Style Soil System and existing rainwater systems, this uPVC pipe bend is an affordable and lighter alternative to cast iron while remaining durable and corrosion-resistant. product.description:
This 112.5° spigot bend helps to bring your downpipe as close to the wall as possible, avoiding obtrusions or obstacles, ensuring water runs vertically and reducing debris build-up. With a range of heritage colours to choose from, this spigot bend can fit the architectural needs of your building.
 Fitting with the Cast Iron Style Round downpipes, this spigot bend can be incorporated with the Roundstyle or Deepstyle Domestic Rainwater System at 68mm diameter and with the Deepstyle High Capacity Rainwater System at 105mm diameter. Ideal for period styled new builds, traditionally designed buildings and renovation projects, this uPVC spigot bend has authentic detailing and finish making it a perfect replacement for traditional cast iron styling as an affordable, lighter alternative. Blending perfectly with the architectural detail of heritage buildings, this spigot bend gives the appearance of original Cast Iron systems. product.name: Brett Martin Cascade Cast Iron Style Round Plastic Anti-Splash Pipe Shoe with Lugs
product.description:
This round profiled anti-splash pipe shoe directs rainwater from a 65mm downpipe into the ground level drainage. Featuring the provided lugs for simple securing purposes, this product from Brett Martin’s Cascade range is handy and practical. 
The cast iron style finish combines these sturdy plastic fittings with unique aesthetics that suit contemporary or refurbished builds, especially in those that feature heritage designs. Completely UV stabilised and resilient against the effects of rusting and corrosions, the Cascade collection can effortlessly substitute classic cast iron products in already established or new rainwater systems. product.name: Brett Martin Cascade Cast Iron Style Round Plastic Handed Pipe Shoe with Lugs
product.description:
For downpipes that don’t quite reach the drainage system to expel rainwater from the guttering, this Roundstyle pipe shoe is a fantastic option to continue the path and direct the water into the drain.  
This cast iron style round pipe shoe is a part of the Cascade Roundstyle range by Brett Martin and is available for purchase as a left or right-handed fitting. Featuring installed lugs to aid with forming secure attachments to walls or chosen hard surfaces, this pipe shoe is an efficient but also stylish way of finishing off your Cascade downpipe system and therefore distributing rainfall out from your gutters and into the correct drain. product.name: Brett Martin Cascade Cast Iron Style Round Plastic Downpipe Clip
product.description:
These downpipe clips are part of the Roundstyle Cast Iron Style Rainwater System, synonymous with traditional cast iron styling and blends perfectly with the architectural detailing on heritage buildings, being virtually indistinguishable from original Cast Iron systems.
The authentic styling of the Roundstyle system is suitable for both period styled new build and renovation projects alike.
Secures a downpipe to the wall - there should be one positioned near the top of the first pipe and then around every metre after that.
Two sorts are generally available: the saddle bracket and the barrel clip.
The saddle bracket just holds the pipe away from the wall while the barrel clip gives a firmer grip to the pipe and prevents it moving up and down.
Cascade Cast Iron Style Guttering
Achieve all the benefits of plastic guttering with all the traditional and period style looks of Cascade Cast Iron Style guttering. Manufactured from plastic, the guttering is designed to look like cast iron so it’s a match to heritage and listed properties. As the plastic cast iron style guttering isn’t as heavy as actual cast iron guttering you can be reassured that installing new guttering won’t make any damage to the property.

product.name: Alumasc Aqualine Deep Run Fascia Bracket
product.description: Manufactured to provide support for the Aqualine Deep Run extruded aluminium gutter system, this Deep Run fascia bracket is lightweight and easy to install. Available in a range of colours, this fascia bracket has a factory-applied BBA approved polyester powder coating to match your Deep Run gutter system.This straightforward fascia bracket is appropriate for both flush and projecting eaves applications and can be fixed to building fabric with the only remaining assembly needed by a simple clip fix. This simple installation process involves dropping and locking the Deep Run guttering onto this concealed fascia bracket with locked and aligned internal joints using slide bars ensuring a fully secured guttering. This unique, all-weather ‘dry’ jointing system gives a clean exterior which contributes to the smooth lines and intricate detailing and improves and complements the appearance and architectural character of modern designed buildings. Made from robust and non-corrodible aluminium, this fascia bracket requires minimal maintenance.Features & Benefits: Alumasc Aqualine Deep Run Fascia BracketAvailable in a wide range of colours to match your Deep Run gutters  BBA certified factory-applied polyester powder coatings  Provides support for the Aqualine Deep Run extruded aluminium gutter system  Environmentally friendly and made from recyclable aluminium  Made from robust and non-corrosive aluminium with minimal maintenance needed  Lightweight and easy to handle and fix  Ideal for both flush or projecting eaves  110mm x 85mm size  Made from aluminium with a life expectancy of 40 years (rural/suburban areas) and up to 25 years (industrial/marine areas)  Made in the UK to British standards  Made with aluminium extrusions 6063 T6 alloy to BS EN 573: BS EN 755, BS EN 12020 and BS 9101This Deep Run fascia bracket is part of an efficient and compact rainwater system, enhancing high flow capacity and performance and fully accommodating free linear thermal movement at every joint. The Aqualine Deep Run guttering, supported by this fascia bracket is suitable for areas that experience higher than average rainfall or in areas where large quantities of water need to be dealt with.
product.variant_name: Alumasc Aqualine Deep Run Fascia Bracket in Metallic Silver - 110mm x 85mm

product.name: Alumasc Aqualine Deep Run External Angle
product.description: This deep run external angle from Alumasc’s Aqualine guttering range has all the benefits of an Aqualine half round external angle – designed to explore outwardly (external) corners of a roofline and avoid any potential obstructions – but does it with a deeper profile that can contain more water and therefore withstand a greater amount of rain. The Aqualine deep run external angle can be provided as a 90º or 135º as per your needs, and maintains a high-performing product within the strong and effective Aqualine collection. Aqualine aluminum guttering looks great on contemporary builds with the potential for hidden fixings and the fact that it can be installed either flush against the eave or slightly away from it. Made with movement from thermal change in mind, this range is innovative and modern, as well as environmentally friendly with 100% recyclable materials. Features & Benefits: Alumasc Aqualine Deep Run External AngleWide colour palette with polyester powder coatings approved by BBA (British Board of Agrément)  Choice of angles for versatile applications  Aqualine products are patented and ‘Design Registered’  Made to high British standards (BS 1474: 1972, material 6063, T6) in the UK.

product.name: Alumasc Aqualine Deep Run Running Outlet
product.description: The deep run running outlet connects the gutter and downpipe outlet in Aqualine deep run systems so that rainwater can easily continue on and flow through the drainage system without problem. Extruded aluminium is what makes this deep run running outlet so tough and versatile with rigorous defiance against breakage and splintering under changing weather circumstances. The deep run profile sufficiently holds and channels vast quantities of rainwater towards the drainage system, and Alumasc’s advanced technology makes for guttering that looks neat, current, and modern and that can also withstand the common changes of thermal movement at the same time. Compatible with several eave installations and virtually undetectable attachments, this deep run running outlet is one of many Alumasc Aqualine products that is constantly beneficial and commits to peak performance every time.

product.description: Designed to support the extruded aluminium Aqualine Modern gutter system, this fascia bracket is light and easy to install, providing a fully secure installation with smooth lines and intricate detailing for your modern designed building. Including P80 joint seal lubricant, 2 jointing tools, 10 spare slide locks, 20 spare number 12 screws, 8 spares seal strips and 20 shims for filling gaps, this starter pack provides you with the required tools for an easy and successful installation.This quick and easy to install starter pack is compatible with the Aqualine Modern gutter system and uses a unique, all-weather ‘dry’ jointing system with concealed site jointing and fixing, giving the appearance of a completely clean exterior. The Modern gutters can be locked into place by dropping them onto concealed brackets where internal joints are aligned and locked using single front lock slide bars. This ensures a completely secure gutter system and allows free linear thermal movement.Features & Benefits: Alumasc Aqualine Modern Starter PackEnsures a quick and easy installation of your Modern gutter system  Enhances buildings with smooth lines, intricate details and secret fix bracketry to give a completely clean appearance  Environmentally friendly with guttering made from durable, non-corrodible, recyclable aluminium  Easy to handle, lightweight materials  Minimal maintenance required once installed  Available in a range of diameters  Made from long-lasting aluminium with a life expectancy of 40 years (rural/suburban areas) and up to 25 years (industrial/marine areas)This Modern starter pack ensures smooth lines and intricate details with a contemporary and sleek appearance and gutter fittings nearly hidden from view for contemporary designed buildings. With enhanced performance from the high flow capacity guttering, the modern gutter systems are ideal for both flush and projecting eaves applications. This starter pack is available in a range of gutter diameters and will help you with your installation needs.

product.name: Brett Martin Cascade Cast Iron Style Rectangular Plastic 112.5 Degree Side Spigot Offset
product.description:
This 112.5 degree bend will allow you to keep your downpipe as close to the wall as possible to ensure vertical water runs. This will reduce debris build up and keep your guttering system high capacity for longer.
Cascade Cast Iron Style Guttering
Achieve all the benefits of plastic guttering with all the traditional and period style looks of Cascade Cast Iron Style guttering. Manufactured from plastic, the guttering is designed to look like cast iron so it’s a match to heritage and listed properties. As the plastic cast iron style guttering isn’t as heavy as actual cast iron guttering you can be reassured that installing new guttering won’t make any damage to the property.
The high capacity 170mm deepstyle guttering can be installed on residential projects, commercial projects and traditional church or school buildings too. The gutters are designed to hold a high capacity of water so any roofs with a large surface area can benefit from Cascade Cast Iron Style guttering. Choose between ogee, bath, motiffed and gothic hoppers to complement your cast iron style guttering and to achieve the period detailing so common in cast iron materials. The authentic-looking hoppers will give an attractive finishing touch whilst remaining affordable and resistant to corrosion.
Install Cascade Cast Iron Style guttering with a 12mm slope at 3m intervals for maximum water flow towards outlets and fix the gutters in place at a minimum of 1m intervals.

product.name: Alumasc Aqualine Moulded 3m Gutter Assembly
product.description: Supplied with a moulded gutter and applicable brackets, union clips, and sidelocks for reliable and unwavering installation, this 3m moulded gutter assembly allows you to set up an Alumasc aluminium gutter run within the rest of an Aqualine system.Aqualine is one of Alumasc’s several high-performing rainwater ranges. The moulded profile is one of three, and poses a modern take on the ogee gutter system. It suits an assortment of contemporary builds with unique styles and sleek, undetectable fixings while being versatile in eave applications (either flat against the eave or projected from it). Even better, the moulded range still accommodates high-level flow capacities and has the potential to last up to 40 years. 3m gutter assemblies are an excellent and cost-efficient means of applying your gutter run that exceeds expectations and conforms to high British standards.Features & Benefits: Alumasc Aqualine Moulded 3m Gutter AssemblyIncludes multiple polyester powder coloured coatings that are BBA (British Board of Agrément) approved  Moulded profile for cooperation with the moulded range  British standard aluminium extrusions (BS 1474: 1972, material 6063, T6)  Produced in the UK  Includes fixings for sturdiness and support  Doesn’t require extensive maintenance  Can be recycled.
product.variant_name: Alumasc Aqualine Moulded 3 Metre Gutter Assembly in Black - 140mm x 100mm

product.name: Alumasc Aqualine Moulded External Angle
product.description:
This external moulded angle is part of Alumasc's 'Aqualine' range of guttering products, combining traditional design elements and aesthetics with highly durable modern materials to produce an excellent all-rounder for your next domestic guttering project. Emulating the moulded guttering profiles of period cast iron, these external angles are a perfect addition to traditional properties looking to keep their Victorian charm.However, period design no longer means putting up with the cost and added installation woes of cast iron. This range of guttering products is constructed using recycled aluminium and a long-lasting polyester powder coating approved by the British Board of Agrément (BBA). Under the right conditions, this durable combination of materials can last up to 40 years in suburban and rural areas, making for a durable and reliable system. In addition, the Aqualine range is lightweight and easy to handle, taking into account heat warping thanks to a clever notched design and keeping a watertight seal with sliding lock bars and dry joint seals.
Features & Benefits: Alumasc Aqualine Moulded External AngleDurable powder-coated aluminium constructionLong-lasting performance, up to 40 years of life in suburban and rural areasBritish Board of Agrément-approved designWatertight and secure seals thanks to sliding lock barsNotched design takes into account heat warping in higher temperaturesStylish traditional 'moulded' profile is perfect for period properties
product.variant_name: Alumasc Aqualine Moulded 90dg External Angle in Mouse Grey - 140mm x 100mm

product.name: Alumasc Aqualine Box Fascia Bracket
product.description: This Box Fascia Bracket has been manufactured to provide support for the Aqualine Box extruded aluminium gutter system. Made from durable and non-corrodible aluminium, this fascia bracket has a life expectancy of 40 years (rural/suburban areas) and up to 25 years (industrial/ marine areas) with minimal maintenance required.This lightweight, straightforward bracket is easy to install and handle. Once fixed to the building fabric, the only remaining assembly is by a simple clip fix, dropping and locking the guttering onto this concealed bracket with locked and aligned internal joints using lock bars to ensure completely secure guttering. This fascia bracket uses a unique, all-weather ‘dry’ jointing system to give a clean external appearance contributing to the smooth lines and intricate detailing to enhance and complement the appearance and architectural character of contemporary designed buildings.Features & Benefits: Alumasc Aqualine Box Fascia BracketManufactured in the UK to British standards  Manufactured with aluminium extrusions 6063 T6 alloy to BS EN 573: BS EN 755, BS EN 12020 and BS 9101  Available in a variety of colours to match your gutters  Provides support for the Aqualine Box extruded aluminium gutter system  Made from recyclable aluminium and is environmentally friendly  Manufactured from durable and non-corrodible aluminium with minimal maintenance required  Available in a range of diameters  Suitable for both flush and projecting eaves  Easy to install and lightweightSuitable for both flush and projecting eaves applications and available in a wide range of sizes and in a variety of colours with BBA approved factory-applied polyester powder coatings to match your gutter system.  This Box fascia bracket is part of a compact and efficient rainwater system that enhances high flow capacity and performance and fully accommodates free linear thermal movement at every joint. The Aqualine Box guttering, supported by this fascia bracket has a box profile with a rectangular trough shape to maximise water flow capacity and gives a striking angular appearance with a uniform shape.

product.name: Alumasc GX Moulded 3m Gutter Assembly
product.description: Designed to collect rainwater from the bottom of your roof, this gutter assembly provides you with a gutter run that channels the water away into a downpipe and into the rainwater system below. This high-capacity gutter is suitable for traditional or modern buildings and has been manufactured as part of the pressed aluminium GX Moulded gutter system.Made with moulded sides and a returned lip, this gutter assembly is part of a gutter system that has been fully engineered for a traditional, well-proven installation method of simple wet sealed and bolted joints, fixed directly to your building fabric. With a straightforward screw fixing with bracketry, generally concealed after fixing, this gutter assembly is lightweight and easy to install with minimal maintenance required after installation. This gutter assembly can be exposed or designed within a Skyline fascia system, is fully compatible with Alumasc’s Skyline fascia/soffit system and can provide an all-aluminium eaves/soffit solution.Features & Benefits: Alumasc GX Moulded 3m Gutter AssemblyMade in the UK to British Standards and pressed from sheet aluminium  Available in a selection of colours with factory-applied BBA certified polyester powder coatings  Made from durable, non-corrosive aluminium with minimal maintenance required for a long-lasting installation  Made from 100% recyclable, environmentally friendly aluminium  Perfect for applications where maximum capacity gutters are required  Available in a selection of diameters  Easy to install with a simple, well-proven method and light in weight to handle  Wet jointed and fixed directly to building fabricThis robust and non-corrodible aluminium gutter assembly can reduce the risk of heat damage, avoiding splitting and cracking by fully accommodating thermal movement at every joint. Available in a selection of diameters and colours, this gutter assembly is coated with factory-applied BBA approved polyester powder to suit your gutter requirements. Made from long-lasting aluminium, this gutter assembly has a life expectancy of 40 years in suburban/rural areas and up to 25 years in marine/industrial areas.

product.name: Alumasc Aqualine Box Starter Pack
product.description:
This box starter pack is mainly manufactured from aluminium, and is part of the Aqualine range of aluminium guttering from Alumasc. With years of experience in the guttering and rainwater system industry, Alumasc create a range of products that, by using new technologies and manufacturing techniques, not only meet industry standards, but also surpass expectations in terms of quality, performance and style.
This starter pack has been designed specifically for use with box profile guttering from the Aqualine range. The box profile is a contemporary design with sharp angular lines to create a strong visual statement, as well as maximum capacity and efficient flow rates.
The starter pack has been designed to provide you with everything you need to install box profile Aqualine guttering securely, to create a durable and weathertight run of guttering on your property. The box profile starter pack consists of 10 spare lock bars, 20 shims, 2 jointing tools, 20 no.12 screws, 8 spare seal strips and P80 joint and seal lubricant, to create a pristine, built to last finish.
Why choose Alumasc Aqualine guttering?
The Alumasc Aqualine range of guttering is part of the contemporary aluminium rainwater range from Alumasc.
Performance and design
The Alumasc Aqualine guttering system features a number of characteristics that make it one of the highest performing gutter systems available. The design of Aqualine takes into account potential dangers of cracking and splitting due to thermal movement, so at every joint across the gutter system thermal movement can occur without causing damage.
The Aqualine gutter system has also been designed to be installed with concealed fixing and jointing, which not only helps to create a clean external appearance, but also helps minimise the potential for leaks to occur. This is further aided by the dry joint seals, which are secured by sliding lock bars for maximum watertightness.
Installation
The installation process of Alumasc Aqualine is quick and easy, aided by the fact that the gutters are lightweight and easy to handle. Support brackets simply need to be fixed to the building fabric, and then a simple clip fix is all that is required to secure the gutter in place.
Aesthetics
The Aqualine range is available in a vast range of colours, sizes and profiles, which allow a high level of customisation in order to create the perfect look for your project. Whether you’re looking to create a subtle guttering run with relatively traditional profiles, or you want to make the gutters a feature, in bright colours and contemporary profiles, the Alumasc Aqualine range will have exactly what you are looking for, with BBA approved polyester powder coatings, and including all the accessories you’ll need to create a single, uniform look.
Environmentally friendly
The Aqualine guttering range is a compact and efficient rainwater system that is manufactured from 100% recyclable aluminium in the UK. Additionally, the Aqualine guttering system has a life expectancy of 40 years or more in rural or suburban areas, and up to 25 years in industrial and marine environments. This means that not only are less gutter profiles required over time due to their long lasting design, when they are finally replaced they can be recycled.

product.name: Alumasc GX Moulded Internal Angle
product.description: Designed with an internal returned lip and moulded sides, this internal angle is suited for use on the corners of your installation for modern or traditional buildings with your choice of being exposed or designed within a Skyline fascia system. This internal angle has been designed as part of the pressed aluminium GX Moulded gutter system.Durable and fully engineered, this box section internal angle gutter has been designed for a traditional, well-proven method of simply wet sealing and bolting joints fixed directly onto the building fabric and is suitable for traditional or modern buildings. Perfect for applications where maximum capacity gutters are required, this internal angle is designed to fully accommodate thermal movement at every joint, reducing the risk of cracking or splitting through heat damage. Providing an all-aluminium eaves/ soffit solution, this internal angle is fully compatible with Alumasc’s Skyline fascia/soffit solution and requires a simple screw fixing with bracketry which is generally concealed after installation.Features & Benefits: Alumasc GX Moulded Internal AngleManufactured in the UK to British Standards and pressed from sheet aluminium  Available in two different colours with factory-applied BBA approved polyester powder coatings  Made from robust, non-corrodible aluminium for minimal maintenance and a long-lasting installation  Made from environmentally friendly and 100% recyclable aluminium  Ideal for applications where maximum capacity gutters are required  Available in a range of angles and diameters  Lightweight and easy to install with a well-proven and simple method   Wet jointed and fixed directly to the building fabricAvailable in a range of diameters and angles, this lightweight internal angle is made from robust, non-corrodible aluminium with a life expectancy of 40 years (suburban/rural areas) and up to 25 years (marine/industrial areas) with minimal maintenance required after installation. Available in your choice of two colours, this internal angle is coated with factory-applied BBA certified polyester powder.

product.name: Alumasc GX Smooth Internal Angle
product.description: Manufactured as part of the pressed aluminium GX Smooth gutter system, this internal angle has been designed for simple jointing for a sleek appearance without the requirement for sole support brackets and visible screw fixing. This high water-flow capacity internal angle is suitable for both traditional and modern buildings.With sharp-angled bends and an internal returned lip, this internal angle can be exposed or designed to be compatible with a Skyline fascia system and can offer an all-aluminium eaves/ soffit solution. This lightweight and easy to install internal angle uses wet sealed and bolted joints for a well-proven, simple installation method with a straightforward, screw fixing with concealed bracketry. Adapting to thermal movement at every corner and joint, this internal angle has been constructed to reduce the potential for heat damage, avoiding cracks or splits in the gutter system.Features & Benefits: Alumasc GX Smooth Internal AngleFully engineered in the UK to British Standards  Pressed from sheet aluminium to British Standards  Available in two different angles to choose from  Coated in graphite-coloured factory-applied BBA certified polyester powder  Made from durable, non-corrosive aluminium with minimal maintenance required and a long life expectancy  Made from lightweight, recyclable aluminium  Suited for installations where maximum capacity gutters are needed  Easy to fix with a well-proven, straightforward method  Created for simple jointing with a smooth appearance without the need for sole support brackets and visible screw fixing  Suitable for corners of buildings or avoiding protrusions or obstacles where the angles of the roofline changeManufactured from durable, corrosion-resistant, pressed aluminium, this internal angle requires a minimum amount of maintenance and is expected to last 40 years in rural/suburban areas and up to 25 years in industrial/marine areas. Available in two different angles of your choice, this internal angle will fit your box profile gutter system. This graphite-coloured internal angle is made with factory-applied BBA approved polyester powder coatings.

product.name: Alumasc Flushjoint Circular 135 Degree Two Part Offset
product.description: This two part circular offset angles at 135º in order to build a connection between the running outlet and the downpipe of your Flushjoint system, in turn letting the downpipe fix flush against the wall. Made from resilient and quality aluminium, the Flushjoint downpipe collection by Alumasc can be paired and used in tandem with suitably sized items from the Aqualine, GX, and Heritage guttering ranges on recent or refurbished builds. With hidden spigot connections, fittings are designed to seamlessly attach both together and to surfaces, resulting in a neat and tidy finish. Just as the rest of the Flushjoint range, this two part offset is rigid and durable to prevent cracks and leaks. Features & Benefits: Alumasc Flushjoint Circular 135 Degree Two Part OffsetElaborate colour palette, all coated in BBA (British Board of Agrément) approved polyester powder  UK made extruded aluminium (6063 T6 alloy) that meets British standards (BS EN 12020:2001, BS EN 515:1993, BS EN 573:1995, BS EN 755)  Various sizes available  Recyclable to reduce waste.

product.name: Alumasc Flushjoint Square Access Pipe
product.description: This access pipe is from Alumasc’s Flushjoint downpipe collection, particularly from the array of square fittings and guttering they offer. It works in the same manner as a regular downpipe, except it has an opening where you can clear any blockages with relative ease. The Flushjoint range performs just as efficiently as Alumasc’s fellow ranges, to the point that it can be used in tandem with GX, Aqualine and Heritage products that can accommodate to Flushjoint sizes and connections. With an assortment of colour options that all contain BBA approved (British Board of Agrément) polyester powder, this square profile access pipe makes a fantastic contribution to modern or refurbished builds that suit slick and discreet joints. product.name: Alumasc Flushjoint Square 135 Degree Fixed Offset
product.description: With just one part, this 135° fixed offset is one of the multiple products in the Flush joint range from Alumasc. The squared profile works perfectly with other squared profile downpipe systems, connecting them together with smooth hidden spigots.Flushjoint systems attach at the gutter running outlet and connect down towards the downpipe. This offset plays an important part in providing this connection – allowing a 135° angle to keep the downpipes firmly fixed on the wall with appropriate brackets, as well as forming a continuous path for rainfall to find the drainage system. As one of Alumasc’s ranges, Flushjoint is constructed from non-corrosive and long-lasting extruded aluminium suitable for contemporary buildings and modern aesthetics. Although in the Flushjoint range, this square offset can be placed in Heritage, GX, and Aqualine gutters so long as the products are compatible. Features & Benefits: Alumasc Flushjoint Square 135 Degree Fixed OffsetManufactured in the UK to British standards (BS EN 12020:2001, BS EN 515:1993, BS EN 573:1995, BS EN 755)Optional colours with BBA (British Board of Agrément) approved polyester powderSquare profileLow maintenance aluminiumSimple to install with spigotsBeneficial to the environment due to recyclability

product.name: Alumasc GX Joggle Union Clip
product.description:
Designed to join two sections of gutter together while fixed to the fascia board to support the joint, this union clip provides support for the GX Joggle range of pressed aluminium gutter systems. Lightweight and easy to install with a simple, well-proven method, this union clip is part of the GX Joggle installation that can be fixed with wet-sealed and bolted joints with a straightforward screw fixing with bracketry that can be concealed after installation.
Available in a variety of colours with factory-applied BBA certified polyester powder coatings and a range of diameters to match your GX Joggle gutter system. This fully engineered union clip, designed for traditional wet jointing on-site, is ideal for applications where maximum capacity gutters are required. product.name: Alumasc GX Joggle Internal Angle
product.description:
For gutter installations that require sharp turns of a corner or that need to avoid any potential interruptions for a straight path, this joggle internal angle is a fantastic product to connect to a joggle gutter run and therefore ensure water can flow from the gutter to the downpipe. 
This internal angle features a joggle profile as part of Alumasc’s GX joggle range, which makes it ideal to fit in with the joggle system as it shares a distinct design that accommodates heavy rainfall and utilises innovative technology, therefore allowing for thermal movement. GX gutters are suitable for high capacity flow and work fantastically on both traditional and contemporary builds. Joggle installations can be extremely discreet with easy bracketry and top straps, and this internal angle follows in line by subtly connecting to the guttering run.  Features & Benefits: Alumasc GX Joggle Internal AngleSize options to suit different gutters  Resistant to corrosion and rusting  Unlikely to break or leak  Recyclable  BBA (British Board of Agrément) approved  Perfect for longevity installations with a 25-40 year lifespan  Made from British standard aluminium (BS EN 1462:1997, BS EN 612:1996, BS EN 515:1993, BS EN 573:1995, BS EN 485).

product.name: Alumasc GX Joggle Standard Running Outlet
product.description:
This standard running outlet has been manufactured from aluminium and is part of the GX aluminium gutter range from Alumasc. Alumasc have been manufacturing high quality guttering and rainwater systems for years, and use new technologies and innovative manufacturing processes to create products that not only meet industry standards, but also surpass expectations in terms of performance, durability and design.
This standard running outlet has been designed specifically for use with GX guttering products with the joggle profile. The joggle range of GX guttering comprises of vertical sides, sharp angled bends, and a returned lip, and has been designed for use in areas of high rainfall as it copes with large volumes of water with no issues.
The running outlet provides a connection between a gutter run and a downpipe, in order to transport the rainwater from the roof and into the drainage system. The running outlet is most commonly connected to a gutter run towards the side of a house, and is often paired with a stop end to ensure water gets directed into the downpipe.
Why choose Alumasc GX guttering?
Performance
The Alumasc GX gutter range has been designed specifically as a high capacity gutter that can be used on both traditional and modern buildings. The Alumasc GX range is available in three different profiles, but each profile has been designed in a way that delivers maximum capacity and flow rate.
The GX Alumasc range of guttering is designed to fully accommodate thermal movement at every joint, and is lightweight, durable and highly corrosion resistant.
Installation
The GX aluminium guttering range has been designed for traditional wet jointing on site. This involves the simple and well proven method of screw fixing with bracketry, which is generally concealed after installation to create a sleek and uniform finish.
The GX Joggle range is supported by top straps, whilst the GX Smooth range has been designed to not require any visible screw fixing or support brackets to create a smooth finish, whilst the GX Moulded range is wet jointed, fixed directly to the building fabric.
Environmentally friendly
The GX guttering range is a compact and efficient rainwater system that is manufactured from 100% recyclable aluminium in the UK. Additionally, the GX guttering system has a life expectancy of 40 years or more in rural or suburban areas, and up to 25 years in industrial and marine environments. This means that not only are less gutter profiles required over time due to their long lasting design, when they are finally replaced they can be recycled.

A full range of traditional gutter profiles with simple spigot joints, wet sealed and bolted with an extensive range of fixing options. Heritage aluminium gutters are manufactured using modern aluminium casting techniques and are factory finished.
Applications

Ideal for traditionally designed buildings
Used as a direct replacement of cast iron
Also appropriate for modern, fast track contracts
For both flush and projecting eaves applications

Performance

BBA approved
UK manufactured in accordance with BS 2997:1958 (1980)
5 profiles available in a choice of imperial sizes
Lightweight, durable and non-corrodible
Easy to handle and fix
Life expectancy of aluminium: 40 years (rural/suburban areas); up to 25 years (industrial/marine areas)
Aluminium is 100% recyclable

product.name: Alumasc Heritage Aluminium Circular Downpipe
product.description:
This aluminium rounded downpipe by Alumasc is ideal for providing water with an unobstructed and direct path down to the drainage system. Attaching this downpipe to the rest of the Heritage range of guttering is achieved with cast sockets.
As a product from the Heritage collection by Alumasc, this downpipe holds many benefits and advantages – compatible with many eave installations on builds with a more traditional aesthetic, even newer ones, Heritage pipes are unlikely to corrode due to the durable aluminium structures and therefore make any required maintenance simple and fast. The range includes a versatile as-sortment of fitting methods, including wall fixings, brackets, and pipe clips.Features & Benefits: Alumasc Heritage Aluminium Circular DownpipeColour assortment  UK made  Non-heavy but durable  Recyclable extruded aluminium  Created in line with BBA (British Board of Agrément) and quality British standards (BS 8530)  Multiple sizes and lengths to choose from. Like its fellow Heritage guttering items, this circular downpipe is an aluminium extrusion that can have a BBA (British Board of Agrément) approved polyester powder finish that bears a resemblance to cast iron. In turn, this system is an ideal substitute for real cast iron fittings.
product.variant_name: Aluminium Guttering Round Downpipe 63mm x 3m - Black

product.name: Alumasc Heritage Aluminium Circular Downpipe with Ears
product.description:
This round downpipe with ears is made in conjunction with the cast aluminium Alumasc Heritage rainwater system and is a perfect feature for traditionally designed buildings in both refurbishment and new build applications and can be used as a direct alternative for cast-iron downpipes.  Suitable for both flush and projecting eaves installations.
Available in 1, 2 or 3 metre lengths and a range of diameters to fit your needs, this circular downpipe is made from robust and corrosion-resistant aluminium with a life expectancy of 40 years in suburban/rural areas and up to 25 years in marine/industrial areas. Coated with factory-applied BBA approved polyester powder coatings, this downpipe is offered in a variety of colours with the option of a textured black surface to resemble cast iron. This downpipe provides the essential assistance for your gutter system by channelling rainwater from your roof to a drain at ground level.Features & Benefits: Alumasc Heritage Aluminium Circular Downpipe with EarsManufactured in accordance with BS 8530 (previously BS 2997)  Made from extruded aluminium  Made in the UK by Alumasc for the cast aluminium Heritage rainwater system  Ideal for providing traditional architectural features for new build and refurbishment applications  A lightweight alternative for cast iron downpipes   Available in a variety of colours including textured black with BBA approved, factory-applied polyester powder coatings  Durable and non-corrosive aluminium with a life expectancy of 40 years (suburban/rural areas) and up to 25 years (marine/industrial areas)  Easy to install with minimal maintenance requirements  Available in a range of lengths and diameters  Made from environmentally friendly, recyclable aluminium  Compatible with modern fast track building contractsThis extruded aluminium downpipe is easy to fix with pipe jointing for up to 100mm diameters by separate sockets to give maximum flexibility and welded on sockets for the 150mm downpipe. With a straightforward fixing to the wall by eared sockets, this downpipe needs minimal maintenance once installed. Manufactured in the UK to British standards and made from 100% recyclable aluminium.

product.name: Alumasc Heritage Aluminium Circular Pipe Bend
product.description:
A range of traditionally designed, socketed aluminium downpipes. Connections between pipes and fittings are made with loose cast sockets, available with ears for fixing back to the wall. Pipes can also be fixed with a choice of base clips to give alternative projections.Applications

Ideal for traditionally designed buildings
Heritage downpipes are extruded sections with cast sockets
Compatible with all Alumasc aluminium gutter systems
Factory finished, in a choice of 1, 2 and 3 metre pipe lengths

Colours & Finishes

BBA approved polyester powder coatings
In-house powder coating facility
16 standard factory applied colours
BS or RAL colours available to special order
Can be supplied to resemble cast iron surface texture (black) to special order
Also available in plain mill finish for on-site painting

Performance

UK manufactured, extruded aluminium
Choice of circular, square and rectangular pipes
Lightweight, durable and non-corrodible
Easy to handle and fix
Life expectancy of aluminium: 40 years (rural/suburban areas); up to 25 years (industrial/marine areas)
Aluminium is 100% recyclable

Installation & Fixing

Pipe jointing by separate sockets gives maximum flexibility for installation
Simple fixing to wall by eared sockets or by a choice of pipe clips
Minimal maintenance requirements

Ideal for traditionally designed buildings
Used as a direct replacement of cast iron
Also appropriate for modern, fast track contracts
For both flush and projecting eaves applications

BBA approved polyester powder coatings
In-house powder coating facility

BBA approved

5 profiles available in a choice of imperial sizes
Lightweight, durable and non-corrodible
Easy to handle and fix
Life expectancy of aluminium: 40 years (rural/suburban areas); up to 25 years (industrial/marine areas)
Aluminium is 100% recyclable

Installation & Fixing

Wet sealed and bolted joints
Extensive range of fixing options
Minimal maintenance requirements

A full range of traditional gutter profiles with simple spigot joints, wet sealed and bolted with an extensive range of fixing options. Heritage aluminium gutters are manufactured using modern aluminium casting techniques and are factory finished.Applications

Ideal for traditionally designed buildings
Used as a direct replacement of cast iron
Also appropriate for modern, fast track contracts
For both flush and projecting eaves applications

Colours & Finishes

BBA approved polyester powder coatings
In-house powder coating facility
16 standard factory applied colours
BS or RAL colours available to special order
Can be supplied to resemble cast iron surface texture (black) to special order
Also available in plain mill finish for on-site painting

Performance 

BBA approved
UK manufactured in accordance with BS 2997:1958 (1980)
5 profiles available in a choice of imperial sizes
Lightweight, durable and non-corrodible
Easy to handle and fix
Life expectancy of aluminium: 40 years (rural/suburban areas); up to 25 years (industrial/marine areas)
Aluminium is 100% recyclable

Installation & Fixing

Wet sealed and bolted joints
Extensive range of fixing options
Minimal maintenance requirements

product.name: Freeflow Half Round Plastic Gutter Angle
product.description:
Freeflow is a range of innovative, high quality PVC-U rainwater systems that are the result of Freefoam’s culture of continuous innovation and investment in research and development. The Freeflow range has been designed to ensure both reliable, leak-free performance and quick installation. In addition, it is compatible with other rainwater systems with a range of adaptors. Freeflow products come in a range of standard colours including white, black and brown.
Each rainwater system is co-extruded with a white interior and a range of exterior colours - Freefoam’s new innovative solution to the problems associated with rapid heat absorption and expansion of gutters. Widely published test results show that while a white surface exposed to sunshine can absorb heat and attain a surface temperature 10ºC or more over the air temperature, dark surfaces can rise a further 30-40ºC and exceed the softening point of the PVC. On large capacity gutters with a large surface area facing the sun, this can be a particular problem. While the interior will be exposed to sunlight as normal, its absorption of heat from the sun and subsequent expansion along its width and length will be significantly reduced, thus dramatically decreasing the probability of any associated problems.

product.description:
These Freeflow half round stopend outlets are part of a reliable and durable PVC gutter system with excellent longevity and plenty of practical selling points. Made in a straightforward half round style, this system ensures a watertight seal throughout its life thanks to a dedicated seal built into the stopend. A combination of white interior colouring and co-extruded construction means that this range is highly resistant to heat, combating the potential softening of PVC over time, increasing the nominal service life and avoiding common issues like heat warping.The sturdy and reliable PVCu structure is both reliable and resilient, and doesn't hinder in the face of impact or weathering. With leakproof and water-tight seals, this stopend outlet is fully equipped to make for long-lasting use. The co-extruded layers involve white interiors and coloured exteriors which aim to reduce heat absorption and breakage.

product.name: Freeflow Plastic Square Downpipe Connector
product.description:
Freeflow is a range of innovative, high quality PVC-U rainwater systems that are the result of Freefoam’s culture of continuous innovation and investment in research and development. The Freeflow range has been designed to ensure both reliable, leak-free performance and quick installation. In addition, it is compatible with other rainwater systems with a range of adaptors. Freeflow products come in a range of standard colours including white, black and brown.
Each rainwater system is co-extruded with a white interior and a range of exterior colours - Freefoam’s new innovative solution to the problems associated with rapid heat absorption and expansion of gutters. Widely published test results show that while a white surface exposed to sunshine can absorb heat and attain a surface temperature 10ºC or more over the air temperature, dark surfaces can rise a further 30-40ºC and exceed the softening point of the PVC. On large capacity gutters with a large surface area facing the sun, this can be a particular problem. While the interior will be exposed to sunlight as normal, its absorption of heat from the sun and subsequent expansion along its width and length will be significantly reduced, thus dramatically decreasing the probability of any associated problems.

product.name: Clearwater Shallow Dig Cesspool
product.description:
Clearwater shallow dig cesspools are a great option for off-mains buildings where the surrounding area means it’s not possible to install a soakaway to go hand in hand with a septic tank or sewage treatment plant. Clearwater cesspools are for use in situations where there is a high winter water table, where the area of installation is a protected zone or if the soil it will be installed in to is the wrong type to allow a drainage field to be installed.
These shallow dig cesspools have 1 inlet and a lid, which can be removed for the contents to be pumped out by a specialist operator. As a total containment tank, these shallow dig cesspools from Clearwater can be used for the storage of surface water, animal waste, as rainwater harvesting reservoirs and as firefighting reservoirs in areas where there are no mains connections. This cesspool cannot be used for the storage of drinking water.
By opting for this Clearwater shallow dig cesspool labour costs and installation time is minimised as less ground needs to be excavated. Manufactured from chemically resistant and watertight GRP, on dry sites these cesspools can be backfilled with pea shingles with no concerns over durability or stability on the cesspool.
Please note: For collecting and storing the effluence of a domestic, commercial or industrial building, the smallest capacity cesspool that must be used, to comply with building regulations, is 18000 litres.
product.variant_name: Clearwater Shallow Dig Cesspool - 2800 litres

product.name: Clearwater Shallow Dig Septic Tank
product.description:
Clearwater shallow dig septic tanks are the perfect choice for when sewage treatment plants, which discharge cleaned effluent into the ground, are not suitable. Throughout the Clearwater septic tank range, this is the highest capacity tank and it can store the effluent of up to 47 people, perfect for off-mains domestic properties, holiday homes and static caravans.
To reduce costs and installation time this septic tank is shallow dig, meaning you need to excavate less of the ground where it will be installed. Save on labour costs even more on dry sites too as this septic tank can be backfilled with pea shingles. There’s no need to worry about the durability of this septic tank with pea shingles or concrete backfill as it’s manufactured from strong, chemically resistant and watertight GRP.
99.7% efficient and approved to EN12566-1, these septic tanks are the perfect upgrade from traditional cesspools as they tend to last longer, increase hygiene and have improved efficiency in the treatment of waste.
product.variant_name: Clearwater Shallow Dig Septic Tank - 2800 litres
